title: A4 随机对照试验 RCT
code:
* ===== Stata =====
set obs 120
set seed 2026
egen block = seq(), to(30) block(4)       // 30 个区组、组内 4 人
gen treat = rbinomial(1, 0.5)             // 简单随机（严格 2:2 区组需再抽样）
tab treat
csi 20 10 25 5                            // 干预组事件/非事件=20/10，对照组=25/5 → RD、RR 及 CI；NNT=1/RD
ttest y, by(treat)                        // 连续结局：MD
regress y treat, vce(robust)

* ===== R =====

d$treat <- sample(rep(0:1, 60))           # 120 人简单随机（可用 blockrand 做区组）
library(epiR)
epi.2by2(table(d$treat, d$outcome), method = "cohort.count")   # RR/RD/NNT
t.test(y ~ treat, data = d)
lm(y ~ treat, data = d)

title: A5 准实验设计
code:
* ===== Stata =====
gen did = treat * post
regress y treat post did, vce(cluster id)        // did 系数即 DID 估计
xtset id time
xtreg y ib0.time#i.treat i.time, fe vce(cluster id)   // 事件研究：检验平行趋势
gen time_after = max(0, time - t0)               // ITS 分段回归（t0 = 干预时点）
newey y time post time_after, lag(1)             // Newey-West 处理自相关

* ===== R =====
m <- lm(y ~ treat * post, data = d)              # 交互项系数即 DID
library(sandwich); library(lmtest)
coeftest(m, vcov = vcovCL(m, cluster = ~id))     # 聚类稳健标准误
d$time_after <- pmax(0, d$time - t0)
its <- lm(y ~ time + post + time_after, data = d)   # ITS 分段回归

code:
* ============ 第 0 步：模拟面板数据（贯穿全流程） ============
clear all
set seed 2026

* 60 家医院：id 1-30 公立（treated = 1），31-60 民营（treated = 0）
set obs 60
gen id = _n
gen treated = (id <= 30)          // 处理维度：1 = 公立医院（受集采约束）
gen u_i = rnormal(0, 4)           // 医院层面随机效应（制造院内相关，聚类依据）

* 每家医院 2 类药品：group = 1 集采品种，0 非集采品种
expand 2
bysort id: gen group = _n - 1

* 每个（医院 × 品种）2 期：post = 0 政策前，1 政策后
expand 2
bysort id group: gen post = _n - 1
gen time = post                   // 供 reghdfe absorb() 使用

* ---------- 真实数据生成过程（DGP，内置真实 DDD 效应 δ = -8） ----------
* y = γ0 + γ1·treated + γ2·post + γ3·group
*     + γ12·treated×post + γ13·treated×group + γ23·post×group
*     + δ·treated×post×group + u_i + ε
local g0 100                        // 基组均值（民营 × 非集采 × 政策前）
local g1 10                         // 公立医院整体费用水平更高
local g2 -5                         // 全体时间趋势（普遍控费）
local g3 20                         // 集采品种用量大、费用更高
local g12 -6                        // 偏误 1：公立医院特有趋势（DRG / 取消加成等）
local g13 5                         // 公立医院对集采品种的固定偏好
local g23 -4                        // 偏误 2：集采品种特有趋势（专利到期等）
local delta -8                      // 真实 DDD 效应：集采使公立医院集采品种额外下降 8 万元/月

gen y = `g0' + `g1'*treated + `g2'*post + `g3'*group + ///
        `g12'*treated*post + `g13'*treated*group + `g23'*post*group + ///
        `delta'*treated*post*group + u_i + rnormal(0, 2)

* ---------- 稳健性结局（第 4 步用） ----------
* y_qty：集采品种采购数量（相关结局，真实效应较小 δ = -3）
gen y_qty = 60 + 8*treated - 4*post + 18*group - 3*treated*post + ///
            4*treated*group - 2*post*group - 3*treated*post*group + ///
            u_i + rnormal(0, 3)
* y_dev：与药品无关的耗材费用（安慰剂结局，真实 δ = 0）
gen y_dev = 40 + 5*treated - 2*post + 2*group + 1*treated*post - ///
            1*treated*group + 0.5*post*group + 0*treated*post*group + ///
            0.5*u_i + rnormal(0, 5)

* 数据体检：8 组均值表（Stata 17+；16 及更早用 bysort treated post group: summarize y）
table treated post group, stat(mean y) stat(sd y) nototals
* 期望组均值（噪声平均掉后）：民营 非集采 前 100 / 后 95；民营 集采 前 120 / 后 111；
*                             公立 非集采 前 110 / 后 99；公立 集采 前 135 / 后 112

title: 第 0 步：构造模拟面板数据（贯穿全流程）
code:
# ============ 第 0 步：模拟面板数据（贯穿全流程） ============
set.seed(2026)
N <- 60                                     # 60 家医院
dat <- expand.grid(id = 1:N, group = c(0, 1), post = c(0, 1))
dat$treated <- as.integer(dat$id <= 30)     # 处理维度：1 = 公立医院
dat$u_i     <- rnorm(N, 0, 4)[dat$id]       # 医院层面随机效应（聚类依据）
dat$time    <- dat$post                     # 供 fixest 吸收固定效应

# 真实参数（内置真实 DDD 效应 delta = -8）
g0 <- 100; g1 <- 10; g2 <- -5; g3 <- 20
g12 <- -6; g13 <- 5; g23 <- -4; delta <- -8

dat$y <- with(dat, g0 + g1*treated + g2*post + g3*group +
                   g12*treated*post + g13*treated*group + g23*post*group +
                   delta*treated*post*group + u_i + rnorm(nrow(dat), 0, 2))

# 稳健性结局：y_qty（相关结局，真实 δ = -3）；y_dev（安慰剂结局，真实 δ = 0）
dat$y_qty <- with(dat, 60 + 8*treated - 4*post + 18*group - 3*treated*post +
                      4*treated*group - 2*post*group - 3*treated*post*group +
                      u_i + rnorm(nrow(dat), 0, 3))
dat$y_dev <- with(dat, 40 + 5*treated - 2*post + 2*group + 1*treated*post -
                      1*treated*group + 0.5*post*group + 0*treated*post*group +
                      0.5*u_i + rnorm(nrow(dat), 0, 5))

# 8 组均值表（应与下方期望值接近）
aggregate(y ~ treated + post + group, data = dat, FUN = mean)

title: 第 2 步：模型设定与估计（Stata / R 对应）
code:
* ---------- 模型 A：pooled OLS + 医院聚类稳健标准误 ----------
reg y i.treated##i.post##i.group, vce(cluster id)
est store ddd_ols

* ---------- 模型 B：医院 + 时间固定效应（reghdfe） ----------
reghdfe y i.treated##i.post##i.group, absorb(id time) vce(cluster id)
est store ddd_fe
* 说明：treated、post 主效应被吸收（与 id / time 固定效应共线，输出中标注）；
*       两两交互与三重交互仍可估，δ 与模型 A 相同

title: 第 2 步：模型设定与估计（Stata / R 对应）
code:
library(fixest)

# 模型 A：pooled OLS + 医院聚类稳健标准误（不吸收固定效应）
m_ols <- feols(y ~ treated*post*group, cluster = ~id, data = dat)
summary(m_ols)

# 模型 B：医院 + 时间固定效应（treated、post 因共线被自动移除）
m_fe <- feols(y ~ treated*post*group | id + time, cluster = ~id, data = dat)
summary(m_fe)

# 三重交互系数 δ（fixest 中交互用 ":" 连接，对应 Stata 的 #）
coef(m_fe)["treated:post:group"]

title: 第 3 步：核心系数 δ 的解读与分解验证
code:
* ---------- 3.1 两个 2×2 DID（品种类型 DID，在公立/民营切片上） ----------
reg y i.post##i.group if treated == 1, vce(cluster id)
local did1 = _b[1.post#1.group]          // 期望 ≈ -12（= γ23 + δ）
reg y i.post##i.group if treated == 0, vce(cluster id)
local did2 = _b[1.post#1.group]          // 期望 ≈ -4（= γ23）

* ---------- 3.2 分解：DDD = DID1 - DID2 ----------
display "DID1(品种|公立) = " %5.2f `did1'
display "DID2(品种|民营) = " %5.2f `did2'
display "DDD = DID1 - DID2 = " %5.2f (`did1' - `did2')

* ---------- 3.3 镜像分解（医院类型 DID，在集采/非集采切片上） ----------
reg y i.treated##i.post if group == 1, vce(cluster id)
local did1b = _b[1.treated#1.post]       // 期望 ≈ -14（= γ12 + δ）
reg y i.treated##i.post if group == 0, vce(cluster id)
local did2b = _b[1.treated#1.post]       // 期望 ≈ -6（= γ12）
display "镜像分解：DID(医院|集采) - DID(医院|非集采) = " %5.2f (`did1b' - `did2b')

* ---------- 3.4 与主回归三重交互系数对照（期望 ≈ -8） ----------
reg y i.treated##i.post##i.group, vce(cluster id)
display "主回归三重交互系数 δ = " %5.2f _b[1.treated#1.post#1.group]

title: 第 3 步：核心系数 δ 的解读与分解验证
code:
# 3.1 两个 2×2 DID（品种类型 DID 在公立/民营切片上）
did1 <- coef(feols(y ~ post*group | id, cluster = ~id, data = dat[dat$treated == 1, ]))["post:group"]
did2 <- coef(feols(y ~ post*group | id, cluster = ~id, data = dat[dat$treated == 0, ]))["post:group"]
c(DID1 = unname(did1), DID2 = unname(did2), DDD = unname(did1 - did2))
# 期望：DID1 ≈ -12，DID2 ≈ -4，DDD ≈ -8 = δ

# 3.2 镜像分解（医院类型 DID 在集采/非集采切片上），期望 ≈ -8
d1 <- coef(feols(y ~ treated*post | id, cluster = ~id, data = dat[dat$group == 1, ]))["treated:post"]
d2 <- coef(feols(y ~ treated*post | id, cluster = ~id, data = dat[dat$group == 0, ]))["treated:post"]
unname(d1 - d2)

# 3.3 与主回归三重交互系数对照（期望 ≈ -8）
coef(m_fe)["treated:post:group"]

title: 第 4 步：平行趋势与稳健性（识别假设、动态检验、安慰剂、替换结局）
code:
* ---------- 动态检验思路（示意，需多期数据；本模拟两期无法执行） ----------
* 假设 time = -2..2，政策时点 = 0，基准期 = -1：
* reghdfe y ib(-1).time##i.treated##i.group, absorb(id) vce(cluster id)
* 关注各期 1.time#1.treated#1.group 系数（政策前应 ≈ 0）
* 画图：ssc install coefplot; coefplot, keep(*.time#1.treated#1.group) vertical yline(0)
* 具体 keep 匹配规则以 help coefplot 为准

* ---------- 安慰剂 1：伪第三维度（Stata permute，200 次） ----------
* 随机置换 group，破坏品种维度结构；真实 δ = -8 应落在置换分布左尾之外
permute group delta = _b[1.treated#1.post#1.group], ///
        reps(200) seed(2026): reg y i.treated##i.post##i.group, vce(cluster id)

* ---------- 安慰剂 2：伪时点（示意，需 time = 0..3 的多期数据） ----------
* gen post_fake = (time == 1)        // 把政策提前到 t=1，只用真政策前数据
* reg y i.treated##i.post_fake##i.group if time < 2, vce(cluster id)  // 期望 δ ≈ 0

* ---------- 替换结局 ----------
reghdfe y_qty i.treated##i.post##i.group, absorb(id time) vce(cluster id)  // 相关结局：期望 δ ≈ -3
reghdfe y_dev i.treated##i.post##i.group, absorb(id time) vce(cluster id)  // 安慰剂结局：期望 δ ≈ 0

* ---------- 聚类层级敏感性：多向聚类（reghdfe 支持） ----------
reghdfe y i.treated##i.post##i.group, absorb(id time) vce(cluster id time)

title: 第 4 步：平行趋势与稳健性（识别假设、动态检验、安慰剂、替换结局）
code:
# ---------- 安慰剂 1（R 版）：伪第三维度，医院内随机交换品种标签，200 次 ----------
set.seed(2026)
perm_delta <- replicate(200, {
  d <- dat
  d$group_p <- ave(d$group, d$id, FUN = sample)      # 每家医院内部重排，保留医院结构
  coef(feols(y ~ treated*post*group_p | id + time, data = d))["treated:post:group_p"]
})
hist(perm_delta, main = "伪第三维度：δ 的置换分布（200 次）")
abline(v = -8, col = "red", lwd = 2)                 # 真实 δ = -8 应落在左尾之外
mean(perm_delta <= -8)                               # 置换单侧 p 值（期望接近 0）

# ---------- 替换结局 ----------
coef(feols(y_qty ~ treated*post*group | id + time, cluster = ~id, data = dat))["treated:post:group"]  # 期望 ≈ -3
coef(feols(y_dev ~ treated*post*group | id + time, cluster = ~id, data = dat))["treated:post:group"]  # 期望 ≈ 0

# 伪时点（示意，需 ≥3 期数据）：把政策时点前移后用真政策前数据估计 δ，期望 ≈ 0；
# 写法同上，仅替换 post 变量与子样本（以 fixest 帮助文档为准）

code:
* ============================================================
* 模拟面板：60 地区 × 4 期；30 个处理组交错入组；真实 ATT = -150
* ============================================================
clear all
set seed 2026
set obs 60
gen id = _n
* 处理时点 g（0 = 永不受理）
gen g = 0
replace g = 2 if inrange(id, 1, 10)
replace g = 3 if inrange(id, 11, 20)
replace g = 4 if inrange(id, 21, 30)
gen treated = (g > 0)
* 地区特征（时不变）：固定效应、自身趋势、可观测协变量
gen alpha = rnormal(900, 50)        // 地区平均次均费用水平
gen beta  = rnormal(-8, 4)          // 地区自身趋势（元/期）
gen x1 = rnormal(0.3*treated, 1)    // 协变量 1：与入选相关
gen x2 = rnormal(0, 1)              // 协变量 2

title: 第 0 步：生成贯穿全文的模拟面板数据
code:
# ============================================================
# 模拟面板：60 地区 × 4 期；30 个处理组交错入组；真实 ATT = -150
# ============================================================
set.seed(2026)
N <- 60; Tmax <- 4
id  <- 1:N
g   <- c(rep(2, 10), rep(3, 10), rep(4, 10), rep(0, 30))   # 处理时点；0 = 永不受理
treated <- as.integer(g > 0)
alpha <- rnorm(N, 900, 50)          # 地区固定效应
beta  <- rnorm(N, -8, 4)            # 地区自身趋势
x1 <- rnorm(N, 0.3 * treated, 1)    # 协变量 1：与入选相关
x2 <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)                # 协变量 2

dat <- expand.grid(id = id, t = 1:Tmax)
dat$g <- g[dat$id]; dat$treated <- treated[dat$id]
dat$alpha <- alpha[dat$id]; dat$beta <- beta[dat$id]
dat$x1 <- x1[dat$id]; dat$x2 <- x2[dat$id]
dat$D <- as.integer(dat$t >= dat$g & dat$g > 0)
dat$y <- dat$alpha + dat$beta * (dat$t - 1) - 30 * (dat$t - 1) +
         (-150) * dat$D + rnorm(N * Tmax, 0, 40)                       # 次均药品费用
dat$adm <- 0.20 - 0.01 * (dat$t - 1) + (dat$alpha - 900) / 3000 +
           (-0.02) * dat$D + rnorm(N * Tmax, 0, 0.04)                  # 住院率

table(dat$g)                        # 队列规模
aggregate(y ~ treated + t, data = dat, FUN = mean)     # 各期均值（干预前应接近）

gen ev_m1 = (rel == -1 & treated3 == 1) // 基准（回归中省略）

gen ev_1  = (rel ==  1 & treated3 == 1)

code:
* ---------- 6.1 伪处理组（随机重抽处理组身份，500 次） ----------
preserve
keep if inlist(t, 1, 2)
gen post = (t == 2)
tempname pf
tempfile pfres
postfile `pf' b_did using `pfres', replace
set seed 2026
forvalues r = 1/500 {
    * 在地区层面抽一个伪处理身份（同一地区两期身份一致）
    bysort id: gen rnd_id = runiform() if _n == 1
    bysort id (rnd_id): replace rnd_id = rnd_id[1]
    egen prank = rank(rnd_id), unique
    gen treatedF = (prank <= 10)          // 随机 10 个伪处理地区
    quietly reg y i.treatedF##i.post, vce(cluster id)
    post `pf' (_b[1.treatedF#1.post])
    drop rnd_id prank treatedF
}
postclose `pf'
use `pfres', clear
summarize b_did, detail                  // 伪系数分布：中心应 ≈ 0
count if b_did <= -150                   // 伪系数 ≤ 真实系数（-150）的次数
di (r(N) + 1) / 501                      // 经验 p 值（单侧）
histogram b_did, normal xline(-150, lcolor(red))
* 备选：ritest（SSC）做随机化推断，支持聚类层级（选项以 help ritest 为准）
restore

* ---------- 6.2 伪时点（预期效应检验） ----------
* 用 g=3 队列的干预前两期（t=1,2），人为假设 t=2 已干预
preserve
keep if inlist(g, 0, 3) & inlist(t, 1, 2)
gen post = (t == 2)
gen treated3 = (g == 3)
reg y i.treated3##i.post, vce(cluster id)     // 预期系数 ≈ 0
restore

* ---------- 6.3 剔除部分样本 ----------
* (a) 剔除 y 上下 1% 极端值后重估 2×2
preserve
keep if inlist(t, 1, 2)
gen post = (t == 2)
gen treated2 = (g == 2)
quietly summarize y, detail
drop if y < r(p1) | y > r(p99)
reg y i.treated2##i.post, vce(cluster id)
restore
* (b) 对照只用永不受理组（排除尚未处理队列），多期 FE 估计
preserve
keep if inlist(g, 0, 2)
gen post = (t >= 2)
gen treated2 = (g == 2)
reghdfe y i.treated2#i.post, absorb(id t) vce(cluster id)
restore

* ---------- 6.4 PSM-DID ----------
preserve
keep if inlist(t, 1, 2)
gen post = (t == 2)
gen treated2 = (g == 2)
* 方案 A（官方 teffects）：横截面 ATT 演示（把两期分别视为观测）
teffects psmatch (y) (treated2 x1 x2), atet
* 方案 B（psmatch2 + DID，SSC；实务常用）：按干预前协变量匹配后做 DID
psmatch2 treated2 x1 x2, out(y) logit common
pstest x1 x2, both                        // 匹配后平衡性：标准化差异应 < 0.1
reg y i.treated2##i.post [pw = _weight], vce(cluster id)
est store m_psm
* 注：psmatch2 生成的 _weight 为匹配权重；以 help psmatch2 为准
restore

* ---------- 6.5 更换结局与聚类层级 ----------
preserve
keep if inlist(t, 1, 2)
gen post = (t == 2)
gen treated2 = (g == 2)
reg adm i.treated2##i.post, vce(cluster id)      // 结局换为住院率：预期 ≈ -0.02
est store m_adm
* 聚类层级敏感性：地区 → 更保守的层级（示例：每 3 个地区并为一组）
egen group3 = group(ceil(id/3))
reg y i.treated2##i.post, vce(cluster group3)    // 聚类数变少，标准误通常变大
restore

code:
# 接第 2 步的 d2（t ∈ {1,2}；post、treated2 已定义）
library(fixest)

# ---------- 6.1 伪处理组（500 次随机重抽） ----------
set.seed(2026)
ids <- unique(d2$id)
b_null <- replicate(500, {
    fake <- sample(ids, 10)                      # 随机 10 个伪处理地区
    d2$treatedF <- as.integer(d2$id %in% fake)
    m <- feols(y ~ treatedF * post | id + t, data = d2, cluster = ~id)
    coef(m)["treatedF:post"]                     # 系数名以 coef(m) 输出为准
})
pval <- (sum(b_null <= -150) + 1) / 501          # 经验 p 值（单侧）
hist(b_null, breaks = 30, main = "伪处理组 DID 系数分布")
abline(v = -150, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# ---------- 6.2 伪时点 ----------
d_pre <- subset(dat, g %in% c(0, 3) & t %in% 1:2)
d_pre$post <- as.integer(d_pre$t == 2)
d_pre$treated3 <- as.integer(d_pre$g == 3)
feols(y ~ treated3 * post | id + t, data = d_pre, cluster = ~id)   # 预期 ≈ 0

# ---------- 6.3 剔除极端值 ----------
q <- quantile(d2$y, c(0.01, 0.99))
d2t <- subset(d2, y > q[1] & y < q[2])
feols(y ~ treated2 * post | id + t, data = d2t, cluster = ~id)

# ---------- 6.4 PSM-DID ----------
library(MatchIt)
d2pre <- subset(d2, t == 1)
m.out <- matchit(treated2 ~ x1 + x2, data = d2pre, method = "nearest", ratio = 1)
summary(m.out)                       # 匹配后标准化均值差应 < 0.1
# library(cobalt); love.plot(m.out)  # 平衡性图
md  <- match.data(m.out)             # 匹配样本（含 weights）
d2m <- subset(d2, id %in% unique(md$id))
feols(y ~ treated2 * post | id + t, data = d2m, cluster = ~id)

# ---------- 6.5 更换结局与聚类层级 ----------
feols(adm ~ treated2 * post | id + t, data = d2, cluster = ~id)     # 住院率 ≈ -0.02
d2$group3 <- ceiling(d2$id / 3)
feols(y ~ treated2 * post | id + t, data = d2, cluster = ~group3)   # 更保守聚类

code:
* =====================================================================
* 模拟数据：48 个月 = 干预前 24（第 1–24 月）+ 干预后 24（第 25–48 月）
* 场景：某院 DRG 付费改革（第 25 个月实施）对次均住院费用（元）的影响
* 内置真实干预效应：
*   β0 = 12000（干预时点基线，元）  β1 = -50（干预前趋势，元/月）
*   β2 = -600 （即时水平变化，元）  β3 = -30（斜率变化，元/月）
* 误差：AR(1)，rho = 0.3，扰动标准差 200 元
* =====================================================================
clear all
set seed 2026
set obs 48
gen time        = _n
gen time_c      = time - 25               // 中心化：干预时点 = 0
gen level       = time >= 25              // 干预指示：第 25 个月起 = 1
gen trend_after = time_c * level          // 干预后斜率增量（干预前恒为 0）

* AR(1) 误差
gen e = rnormal(0, 200)
forvalues t = 2/48 {
    replace e = 0.3 * e[_n-1] + rnormal(0, 200) if time == `t'
}

* 结局：次均住院费用（元）
gen y = 12000 - 50*time_c - 600*level - 30*trend_after + e

tsset time
twoway (line y time), xline(24.5, lpattern(dash)) ///
    title("模拟月度序列：次均住院费用") ytitle("元") xtitle("月份")

code:
# ---- 6.1 安慰剂时点：假设干预发生在第 13 个月 ----
dat$time_c13 <- dat$time - 13
dat$level13  <- as.numeric(dat$time >= 13)
dat$trend13  <- dat$time_c13 * dat$level13
m_placebo <- lm(y ~ time_c13 + level13 + trend13, data = dat)
coeftest(m_placebo, vcov = NeweyWest(m_placebo, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE))
# 期望：level13、trend13 接近 0 且不显著

# ---- 6.2 季节性：加入月度虚拟变量 ----
dat$month <- factor(((dat$time - 1) %% 12) + 1)
m_season <- lm(y ~ time_c + level + trend_after + month, data = dat)
coeftest(m_season, vcov = NeweyWest(m_season, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE))
# 更平滑的季节建模可用正弦/余弦对（Fourier terms），以数据周期为准

# ---- 6.3 控制组 ITS（CITS）：面板数据交互项 ----
# 面板长表 panel：id、time、y、treat（1 = 干预地区）
panel$t_c  <- panel$time - 25
panel$lev  <- as.numeric(panel$time >= 25)
panel$tr_a <- panel$t_c * panel$lev
m_cits <- lm(y ~ t_c + treat + lev + tr_a + treat:lev + treat:tr_a, data = panel)
coeftest(m_cits, vcov = NeweyWest(m_cits, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE))
# 政策效应 = treat:lev（即时）与 treat:tr_a（斜率）的系数

# ---- 6.4 异常值敏感性：1%/99% 缩尾 ----
q <- quantile(dat$y, c(0.01, 0.99))
dat$y_w <- pmin(pmax(dat$y, q[1]), q[2])
m_w <- lm(y_w ~ time_c + level + trend_after, data = dat)
coeftest(m_w, vcov = NeweyWest(m_w, lag = 1, prewhite = FALSE))

# ---- R：生成模拟数据（N = 1000，可全程复现）----
set.seed(2026)
n <- 1000

  id        = 1:n,
  age       = round(rnorm(n, 65, 12)),        # 年龄
  sex       = rbinom(n, 1, 0.52),             # 1 = 女
  comorb    = rpois(n, 1.5),                  # 合并症计数
  insurance = sample(c("城职", "城居", "新农合"), n, replace = TRUE,
                     prob = c(0.4, 0.3, 0.3)),
  los       = rpois(n, 7) + 1                 # 住院天数
)
dat$age    <- pmin(pmax(dat$age, 18), 95)
dat$comorb <- pmin(dat$comorb, 8)
for (k in 1:5) dat[[paste0("z", k)]] <- rnorm(n)   # 纯噪声特征

# 结局：同一套真实信号驱动两个结局（分类 + 连续）
lp <- -5 + 0.03 * dat$age + 0.45 * dat$comorb + 0.12 * dat$los +
      0.40 * (dat$insurance == "城职") + 0.25 * dat$sex
dat$highcost <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(lp))      # 高费用 yes/no（约 25%）
dat$cost <- exp(7.5 + 0.01 * dat$age + 0.18 * dat$comorb + 0.05 * dat$los +
                0.25 * (dat$insurance == "城职") + 0.9 * dat$highcost +
                rnorm(n, 0, 0.5))             # 总费用（元，右偏）
table(dat$highcost); summary(dat)

# ---- 人为制造 10% MCAR 缺失（演示缺失处理用）----
set.seed(2)
dat$comorb[sample(n, 100)] <- NA

# ---- 70 / 15 / 15 拆分 ----
set.seed(3)
dat$split <- sample(rep(1:3, c(700, 150, 150)))   # 1=训练 2=验证 3=测试
tr <- dat[dat$split == 1, ]; va <- dat[dat$split == 2, ]; te <- dat[dat$split == 3, ]

# ---- 缺失值处理：用训练集中位数插补三组（演示；正式研究用 MICE 且在 CV 折内）----
m_med <- median(tr$comorb, na.rm = TRUE)
tr$comorb <- ifelse(is.na(tr$comorb), m_med, tr$comorb)
va$comorb <- ifelse(is.na(va$comorb), m_med, va$comorb)
te$comorb <- ifelse(is.na(te$comorb), m_med, te$comorb)

# 多重插补示例（正式研究用；注意应在 CV 折内进行）

# pool(fit)

# ---- 标准化：只在训练集上计算均值 / SD，再套用到三组 ----

             num.trees = 500, mtry = 3, min.node.size = 10,
             importance = "impurity", probability = TRUE)
rf                                          # OOB 预测误差

p_rf_te <- predict(rf, data = te_m)$predictions[, "1"]   # 测试集概率（仅评估一次）

# ---- XGBoost：xgb.cv 单组参数 + 早停 ----
library(xgboost)
library(Matrix)
mtr <- sparse.model.matrix(highcost ~ . - 1, data = tr_m)
mva <- sparse.model.matrix(highcost ~ . - 1, data = va_m)
mte <- sparse.model.matrix(highcost ~ . - 1, data = te_m)
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(mtr, label = tr_m$highcost)
dval   <- xgb.DMatrix(mva, label = va_m$highcost)
dtest  <- xgb.DMatrix(mte, label = te_m$highcost)

set.seed(12)
cvx <- xgb.cv(params = list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
                            eta = 0.05, max_depth = 3,
                            subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8),
              data = dtrain, nrounds = 500, nfold = 5,
              early_stopping_rounds = 20, verbose = 0)
cvx$best_iteration                                   # 最佳轮数
max(cvx$evaluation_log$test_auc_mean)                # CV AUC

# ---- XGBoost：手动小网格（验证集早停选参）----

res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
  p <- list(objective = "binary:logistic", eval_metric = "auc",
            eta = grid$eta[i], max_depth = grid$max_depth[i],
            subsample = 0.8, colsample_bytree = 0.8)
  xgb.train(params = p, data = dtrain, nrounds = 500,
            watchlist = list(val = dval), early_stopping_rounds = 20, verbose = 0)
})
va_auc <- sapply(res, function(m) m$best_score)       # 各组合验证集 AUC
best_i <- which.max(va_auc)
grid[best_i, ]                                        # 最优参数
best_n <- res[[best_i]]$best_iteration                # 最优轮数

# ============ 第 5 步：队列模拟（R 从头写） ============
T <- 30
p_hsA <- 1 - exp(-0.02)          # 无并发症→卒中（对照）
p_hsB <- 1 - exp(-0.02*0.70)     # 无并发症→卒中（干预）
p_hd  <- 0.010                   # 背景死亡
p_sd  <- 1 - exp(-0.10)          # 卒中后死亡
PA <- matrix(c(1-p_hsA-p_hd, p_hsA, p_hd,
               0,           1-p_sd, p_sd,
               0,           0,      1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
PB <- matrix(c(1-p_hsB-p_hd, p_hsB, p_hd,
               0,           1-p_sd, p_sd,
               0,           0,      1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# 队列模拟：trace(t+1) = trace(t) %*% P；奖励按周期期初状态、权重 1/(1+d)^(t-0.5)
sim <- function(P, c_well, c_sick, u_well, u_sick, dr, T = 30) {
  trace <- matrix(0, nrow = T + 1, ncol = 3)
  trace[1, ] <- c(1, 0, 0)                      # 起始：100% 无并发症
  for (t in seq_len(T)) trace[t + 1, ] <- trace[t, ] %*% P
  w   <- 1 / (1 + dr)^(seq_len(T) - 0.5)        # 半周期校正 + 贴现权重
  cyc <- trace[seq_len(T), ]                    # 第 1..T 周期的期初分布
  cost <- sum((cyc[, 1] * c_well + cyc[, 2] * c_sick) * w)
  qaly <- sum((cyc[, 1] * u_well + cyc[, 2] * u_sick) * w)
  c(cost = cost, qaly = qaly, p_dead = trace[T + 1, 3])
}

resB5 <- sim(PB, 3500, 20000, 0.85, 0.62, 0.05, T)
resA3 <- sim(PA, 3000, 20000, 0.85, 0.62, 0.03, T)
resB3 <- sim(PB, 3500, 20000, 0.85, 0.62, 0.03, T)

real colvector markov_ce(real scalar phs, real scalar phd, real scalar psd,
                         real scalar cw, real scalar cs,
                         real scalar uw, real scalar us,
                         real scalar d, real scalar T)
{
    real matrix  P, trace, cyc
    real colvector w, c, q
    P = ((1-phs-phd, phs, phd) \ (0, 1-psd, psd) \ (0, 0, 1))
    trace = J(T+1, 3, 0)
    trace[1, 1] = 1
    for (t = 1; t <= T; t++) trace[t+1, .] = trace[t, .] * P
    w   = 1 :/ (1+d) :^ ((1::T) :- 0.5)
    cyc = trace[1..T, .]
    c   = colsum((cyc[,1]*cw + cyc[,2]*cs) :* w)
    q   = colsum((cyc[,1]*uw + cyc[,2]*us) :* w)
    return((c \ q))
}
end

title: 7.2 概率敏感性分析（PSA）
code:
* ============ 第 7.2 步：PSA（Stata：rbeta/rgamma/rnormal 循环） ============
* 分布依据：概率→beta；率/RR→lognormal（exp(rnormal)）；成本→gamma；效用→beta
* 注：1000 次 × 30 周期的 .do 循环较慢（数分钟）；可改调第 7.1 步的
* Mata markov_ce() 提速（逻辑完全相同）。
set seed 2026
local N = 1000
local T = 30
matrix PSA = J(0, 4, .)                    // 每行：cA qA cB qB
forvalues i = 1/`N' {
    * ---- 参数抽样 ----
    local p_hsA = 1 - exp(-exp(rnormal(ln(0.02), 0.20)))
    local p_hsB = 1 - exp(-exp(rnormal(ln(0.02), 0.20))*exp(rnormal(ln(0.70), 0.10)))
    local p_hd  = rbeta(24.74, 2449.26)
    local p_sd  = 1 - exp(-exp(rnormal(ln(0.10), 0.15)))
    local cA0   = rgamma(25, 120)
    local cB0   = `cA0' + rgamma(25, 20)
    local cS    = rgamma(25, 800)
    local uW    = rbeta(119.6, 21.1)
    local uS    = rbeta(57.8, 35.4)
    * ---- 对照臂队列模拟（同第 5.1 步循环） ----
    clear
    set obs `=`T'+1'
    gen healthy = .
    gen sick = .
    gen dead = .
    replace healthy = 1 in 1
    replace sick = 0 in 1
    replace dead = 0 in 1
    forvalues t = 2/`=`T'+1' {
        replace healthy = healthy[`t'-1]*(1-`p_hsA'-`p_hd') in `t'
        replace sick    = healthy[`t'-1]*`p_hsA' + sick[`t'-1]*(1-`p_sd') in `t'
        replace dead    = dead[`t'-1] + healthy[`t'-1]*`p_hd' + sick[`t'-1]*`p_sd' in `t'
    }
    gen w = 1/(1+0.05)^(_n-0.5) if _n <= `T'
    gen cA_c = (healthy*`cA0' + sick*`cS')*w
    gen qA_c = (healthy*`uW'  + sick*`uS')*w
    qui sum cA_c
    local cA_t = r(sum)
    qui sum qA_c
    local qA_t = r(sum)
    * ---- 干预臂队列模拟 ----
    replace healthy = 1 in 1
    replace sick = 0 in 1
    replace dead = 0 in 1
    forvalues t = 2/`=`T'+1' {
        replace healthy = healthy[`t'-1]*(1-`p_hsB'-`p_hd') in `t'
        replace sick    = healthy[`t'-1]*`p_hsB' + sick[`t'-1]*(1-`p_sd') in `t'
        replace dead    = dead[`t'-1] + healthy[`t'-1]*`p_hd' + sick[`t'-1]*`p_sd' in `t'
    }
    gen cB_c = (healthy*`cB0' + sick*`cS')*w
    gen qB_c = (healthy*`uW'  + sick*`uS')*w
    qui sum cB_c
    local cB_t = r(sum)
    qui sum qB_c
    local qB_t = r(sum)
    matrix PSA = PSA \ (`cA_t', `qA_t', `cB_t', `qB_t')
}
matrix colnames PSA = cA qA cB qB

* ---- 成本-效果散点图 ----
svmat PSA, names(col)
gen dC = cB - cA
gen dE = qB - qA
twoway (scatter dC dE, msize(tiny) mcolor(gs8%35)), ///
    yline(0, lpattern(dash)) xline(0, lpattern(dash)) ///
    xtitle("增量 QALY") ytitle("增量成本（元）") ///
    title("PSA 成本-效果散点图 (n=1000)") name(ce_scatter, replace)

* ---- CEAC ----
matrix CEAC = J(0, 2, .)
forvalues lam = 0(20000)300000 {
    count if dC - `lam'*dE < 0
    local pce = r(N)/_N
    matrix CEAC = CEAC \ (`lam', `pce')
}
svmat CEAC
line CEAC2 CEAC1, xtitle("阈值 λ（元/QALY）") ///
    ytitle("P(具有成本效果)") name(ceac, replace)

title: 7.2 概率敏感性分析（PSA）
code:
# ============ 第 7.2 步：PSA（R：基础循环 + 绘图） ============
set.seed(2026)
N <- 1000
psa <- matrix(NA, nrow = N, ncol = 4,
              dimnames = list(NULL, c("cA", "qA", "cB", "qB")))
for (i in 1:N) {
  r_hs <- rlnorm(1, meanlog = log(0.02), sdlog = 0.20)   # 卒中发生率
  rr   <- rlnorm(1, meanlog = log(0.70), sdlog = 0.10)   # 干预 RR
  p_hsA <- 1 - exp(-r_hs)
  p_hsB <- 1 - exp(-r_hs * rr)
  p_hd  <- rbeta(1, 24.74, 2449.26)                      # 背景死亡概率
  p_sd  <- 1 - exp(-rlnorm(1, meanlog = log(0.10), sdlog = 0.15))
  cA0   <- rgamma(1, shape = 25, scale = 120)            # 注意：scale= 必须显式
  cB0   <- cA0 + rgamma(1, shape = 25, scale = 20)       #（默认第二参数是 rate）
  cS    <- rgamma(1, shape = 25, scale = 800)
  uW    <- rbeta(1, 119.6, 21.1)
  uS    <- rbeta(1, 57.8, 35.4)
  PAi <- matrix(c(1-p_hsA-p_hd, p_hsA, p_hd,
                  0, 1-p_sd, p_sd,
                  0, 0, 1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  PBi <- matrix(c(1-p_hsB-p_hd, p_hsB, p_hd,
                  0, 1-p_sd, p_sd,
                  0, 0, 1), nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  rA <- sim(PAi, cA0, cS, uW, uS, 0.05, 30)              # 复用第 5.2 步的 sim()
  rB <- sim(PBi, cB0, cS, uW, uS, 0.05, 30)
  psa[i, ] <- c(rA["cost"], rA["qaly"], rB["cost"], rB["qaly"])
}
head(psa)

dC <- psa[, "cB"] - psa[, "cA"]
dE <- psa[, "qB"] - psa[, "qA"]

# 成本-效果散点图（含象限线与阈值线）
plot(dE, dC, xlab = "增量 QALY", ylab = "增量成本（元）",
     main = "PSA 成本-效果散点图 (n = 1000)",
     pch = 16, col = rgb(0, 0, 0, 0.25))
abline(h = 0, lty = 2); abline(v = 0, lty = 2)
abline(a = 0, b = 100000, col = "red")   # λ = 100000 元/QALY 阈值线
text(quantile(dE, 0.05), quantile(dC, 0.95),
     paste0("P(占优) = ", round(mean(dC < 0 & dE > 0), 3)))

# CEAC
lam_grid <- seq(0, 300000, by = 5000)
ceac <- sapply(lam_grid, function(l) mean(dC - l*dE < 0))
plot(lam_grid, ceac, type = "l", xlab = "阈值 λ（元/QALY）",
     ylab = "具有成本效果的概率", main = "CEAC")
abline(h = 0.5, lty = 3); abline(h = 0.95, lty = 3)

* ---- 手工计算（先核对，再交给批量命令）----
gen a = et                      // 试验组事件
gen b = nt - et                 // 试验组非事件
gen c = ec                      // 对照组事件
gen d = nc - ec                 // 对照组非事件
gen lnOR   = ln((a*d)/(b*c))
gen selnOR = sqrt(1/a + 1/b + 1/c + 1/d)
gen OR     = exp(lnOR)
gen loOR   = exp(lnOR - 1.96*selnOR)
gen hiOR   = exp(lnOR + 1.96*selnOR)
gen lnRR   = ln((a/nt)/(c/nc))
gen selnRR = sqrt(1/a - 1/nt + 1/c - 1/nc)
* 零单元处理：a b c d 各 +0.5 后按上式重算（或 metan ..., peto）

* ---- 连续：MD 与 Hedges' g ----
gen MD    = m_t - m_c
gen seMD  = sqrt(sd_t^2/nt + sd_c^2/nc)
gen sp    = sqrt(((nt-1)*sd_t^2 + (nc-1)*sd_c^2)/(nt+nc-2))
gen J     = 1 - 3/(4*(nt+nc) - 9)
gen g     = MD/sp*J
gen seg   = sqrt((nt+nc)/(nt*nc) + g^2/(2*(nt+nc)))
list study year OR loOR hiOR MD seMD g seg

dat$c <- dat$ec; dat$d <- dat$nc - dat$ec
